idea-plugin.name: archvow
idea-plugin.description:
Understand, review and maintain your software architecture without leaving your IDE.

ArchVow connects your IDE to the ArchVow CLI and provides a visual workspace for the project's components, decisions, questions and checks.

Explore your architecture

  • Overview: View architecture status, pending and resolved items, and quick actions such as Check, Next, Doctor and Audit.
  • Components: Explore components, decisions, questions, safety, assumptions, rules, tasks and specifications. Navigate to related components, briefs and code.
  • Commands: Run ArchVow commands through guided forms, review the exact command and read the results inside your IDE.
  • AI skills: Prepare prompts to draft from briefs, find missing questions or risks, implement components and review changes. Review suggestions before keeping them.

Components, commands and results open in one reusable editor tab.

Edit .vow files

Syntax highlighting, inline errors and warnings, folding, Structure view, comments and navigation to referenced components, hazards and Python modules. Vow code blocks in Markdown are supported too.

Stay in control

The ArchVow CLI is the source of truth. Changes run through CLI commands only after you review the command and select Confirm and run. AI-suggested items remain available for review.

Get started: Install the ArchVow CLI, open a project, then open the ArchVow tool window. You can also initialize a new ArchVow project from the IDE.
